shared_elements: schematic human figures shown frontally/in action
row or group of multiple small human figures
human figures with raised or outstretched limbs
group of figures aligned along a horizontal register
justification: Both surfaces show schematic human figures grouped in a horizontal band, drawn as simplified stick-like or silhouetted bodies with splayed limbs, which is about as generic as figural iconography gets. A depicts a row of near-identical, static, tightly packed figures within a framed panel on a shaped stone with chevron borders, whereas B shows a dynamic hunting-type scene with a dominant antlered animal and a bovid surrounded by dispersed, running figures carrying implements, with no framing panel or repeated geometric border.
